decisions.reason: As the core multi-model garage-door operator line, it builds directly on our existing garage-door systems knowledge, installed base and service capabilities, so we can continue improving and commercializing it efficiently.

Although the remote-control operator is close to our operator know-how, the learning it generates can largely be absorbed into the broader operator range, so keeping it as a separate product ties up resources with limited additional knowledge benefit.

The glazed industrial sectional door remains strongly aligned with our industrial door manufacturing, compliance expertise and commercial customer relationships, giving us good scope to interpret market feedback and refine it further.
